## Install

1. Download `Goof-*.zip` below, unzip it and drag **Goof.app** into Applications.
2. This build isn't notarized by Apple, so macOS blocks it the first time:
   - macOS 15 and later: double-click it once, then open System Settings › Privacy & Security and click “Open Anyway” at the bottom.
   - macOS 14: right-click Goof.app in Finder and choose Open.
3. Goof appears in the menu bar at the top right, and walks you through setup the first time.

Without a server, Goof runs in demo mode: the people and messages in rooms are simulated on your Mac. To connect your own server, see [docs/BACKEND.md](https://github.com/Kyle-zhai/goof/blob/main/docs/BACKEND.md).
